summary: Research Ireland's Government of Ireland Postgraduate Scholarship Programme has funded master's-by-research and PhD students in every discipline, including students from outside the EU. Its 2026 awards paid a €25,000 stipend plus fees and research costs — but no 2027 call had been published when we last checked.
covers: A stipend of €25,000 a year (2026 awards).
A contribution to fees of up to €5,750 a year, with up to €4,000 more a year available for non-EU students' fees.
€3,250 a year for eligible direct research costs.
eligibility: Master's-by-research and PhD candidates of any nationality, with a supervisor at an eligible Irish research institution.
Applicants are assessed on the candidate, the research project and the training environment.
how_to_apply: Agree a research project with a supervisor at an Irish university.
Apply online through Research Ireland's portal when a call is open. The 2026 call closed on 23 October 2025.
Your supervisor and referees submit their parts separately.
Watch the Research Ireland funding page for the next call before you plan around it.
watch_out: No 2027 call had been announced on Research Ireland's page when we checked in September 2026, when a call would normally be open.
Success rates have historically been low (under one in five), so apply for other funding too.
The programme is now run by Research Ireland (Taighde Éireann), formerly the Irish Research Council.

costs: Fees, up to €5,750 a year — plus up to €4,000 more a year for non-EU students
Any non-EU fees above €9,750 a year
You or your university — ask whether it waives the difference

documents: A research project agreed with a supervisor at an eligible Irish institution — each supervisor can back only one applicant
Your online application and research proposal, submitted when a call is open
Your supervisor's section and your referees' letters, which they submit themselves
Proof that you are starting a master's or PhD, or are in its first year

faq.a: Not yet announced on Research Ireland's page as of 25 September 2026. The 2026 call closed on 23 October 2025. For news, email postgrad@researchireland.ie or watch the funding page.
Very. Research Ireland reports an average success rate of 18% over the past five years, so apply for other funding at the same time.

faq.q: I have already started my PhD. Can I apply?
faq.a: Yes, if you are in your first year of registration. The programme is open to new entrants and to first-year registered master's and PhD students.
